svg.title: Coarse local MariaDB process-memory observations
svg.desc: Sampled resident high-water memory: Scriptella batch 1000 187.9 MiB, JDBC batch 1000 146.1 MiB, csvsql chunk 1000 894.6 MiB. One local run only, not precise peak RAM. No CI memory measurements.
